_help: Zombie navigation tunables (Skillz, DESIGN §18, scripts/enemies/ai/zombie_nav.gd). nav: path queries go through the zombie's NavigationAgent3D, re-run every repath_interval s (+/- repath_jitter so zombies don't query on the same frame) or sooner when the target has moved target_moved_repath m since the last query (never more often than repath_min_interval). Waypoints are passed by flat (XZ) distance (waypoint_radius) or by walking past them inside pass_corridor, so a waypoint on a ramp lip that sits above/below the feet never makes a zombie orbit. Within direct_chase_dist m (|dy| < direct_chase_dy) of the target it walks straight at it. avoidance: RVO on the agent (2D on XZ; agents whose height ranges don't overlap ignore each other). radius / priority per kind under kinds. max_speed_mult x the zombie's speed caps the safe velocity. body: CharacterBody3D floor settings + a step-up for ledges up to step_up_max m (shape-tested: up, forward, down onto a walkable floor); the model is lowered by the rise and eased back at step_smooth_speed m/s so a step reads as a climb, not a pop. step_up_max 0.45 matches the maps' navmesh agent_max_climb 0.5 (minus margin), so anything the navmesh says is climbable is physically climbable. stuck: a zombie that wants to move but covers less than min_move m in window s escalates one level per window: 1 repath, 2 sidestep (lateral nudge for sidestep_time s, free side picked by a shape test), 3 detour (a navmesh point detour_dist m off to the side/back, walked for up to detour_time s), 4 last resort: if it is at least teleport_min_dist m from every player and out of every player's view, it is moved to the navmesh point teleport_ahead m further along its path (still >= teleport_min_player_dist m from every player and unseen), else respawned at an open spawn (main.respawn_zombie); seen or close -> cycle back to 1. No escalation within crowd_radius m of the target (that is queueing, not stuck). corridor_dy: the corridor pass also needs the zombie's feet (+ the navmesh offset) within this of the segment height. climb_rise: a waypoint whose next segment rises more than this must be reached (no corner cutting into a ramp side). stuck.progress_*: second detector for zombies that move but get nowhere (sliding along a ledge): over progress_window s the path distance left must drop progress_min m unless the target moved progress_target_move m; failing it escalates (from sidestep). ramp_carve: RUNTIME FALLBACK for Mapz (see AI_NAV_REPORT.md): ZombieNav.prepare_nav_region() adds navmesh-only carve strips (width m) along both sides of every wedge ramp/stair from from_height m up, so the navmesh stops joining the ground to a ramp's side; set enabled false once the maps carry their own side carves / curbs. Ledge back-off: a zombie pressed into a wall whose next waypoint is higher than step_up_max goes back to the previous waypoint (the ramp foot) and must reach it. Mapz nav audit (2026-10-19): target_position is only set by repath() (throttle above, never per frame). Waypoint reached = flat < waypoint_radius 0.6 and |dy| < waypoint_dy 1.0 (after the navmesh offset); a waypoint straight overhead never yields a zero direction (steer for the next point). Corner cutting: a corner waypoint is only let go (radius > 0.25 m or corridor pass) when a capsule sweep (raised step_up_max) to the next waypoint is clear. Door rebakes: repath on NavigationServer3D.map_changed (staggered ~0.15 s), not bake_finished. body.hop_*: blocked by something taller than step_up_max but <= hop_max with clear space above -> hop to hop_height m (cooldown hop_cooldown s, not bosses); landing after > land_repath_air s airborne repaths (drop-offs have no off-mesh links). stuck level 2 = hop if a low blocker is ahead, else a ~sidestep_dist m side-step. avoidance.suspend_off_nav: while a zombie moves without nav (boss telegraph / charge / sidestep, Choir channel, grabs: no nav.tick that frame) a watcher node (host only, made on the first tick) replaces its RVO wish with its real motion (0 while it holds still) and discards the safe velocities computed meanwhile, so neither it nor its neighbours act on a stale vector; the next tick resumes from the fresh wish.
